jobs.title: Product Manager - UX/UI Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: As a AI Product Manager at Reonic , you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution. You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences. You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible? You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works. Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg. What you'll do Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration. Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly. Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work. Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested. Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development. Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product. Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data. Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise. Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience. Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development. What Makes You a Great Fit Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment. Strong product sense: You naturally think about customer problems, business impact, and outcomes rather than simply features and output. UX/UI expertise: You have a strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and usability. You care deeply about how a product feels to use. Hands-on approach: You’re comfortable getting into Figma, creating wireframes and prototypes, testing ideas, and iterating on designs yourself. Customer obsession: You enjoy talking to users and can translate qualitative feedback and observed behavior into clear product opportunities. Comfort with ambiguity: You can take an unclear problem, structure it, identify what matters, and move towards a solution without needing every detail defined upfront. Strong communication: You can clearly explain product decisions, design rationale, and trade-offs to engineers, designers, leadership, and other stakeholders. Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions, and follow problems through from initial idea to measurable impact. Technical curiosity: You enjoy working closely with engineers and are interested in understanding the technical constraints and possibilities behind the products you build. AI-native mindset: You’re curious about how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them. Why Join Us? Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy. A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers , giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact. High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves. Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers. A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way. Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks. Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all. About Reonic At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology. Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations. Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast. Location This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg. Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now! jobs.title: AI Product Manager - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)

You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process. Own release testing: Coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and provide clear, actionable feedback to engineering. Coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams. Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience. Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate issues, reproduce problems, and translate findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering. Communicate what's new: Create release notes, run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works. Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers. Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to make better product decisions. Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems. Strong communication: You can clearly communicate with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C2) is required. jobs.title: Freelance Product Manager – AI for Quality & Regulatory
jobs.description: About Acodis Acodis is a Swiss software company based in Winterthur, providing AI-driven document processing for global Life Sciences companies. We help Quality and Regulatory teams move from document-centric to data-driven ways of working. The Mandate We are looking for an experienced freelance Product Manager to turn our AI platform into dedicated product solutions for two use cases. Working directly with management and our product engineering team, you will own both from discovery to market launch. Quality – Batch Record Review: AI-assisted review of executed batch records: checking completeness and correctness of entries, flagging deviations and GMP-relevant exceptions, and shortening review cycles ahead of batch disposition. Regulatory – CMC & Regulatory Submissions: Extraction and reuse of CMC data for submissions (CTD Module 3), consistency checks between source documents and submission content, and support for variations and post-approval changes. Mandate Deliverables Product definition & validation: Customer interviews, validated user workflows and value cases, and engineering-ready specifications and roadmap for both use cases. Pilot support: In our running pilots, including success criteria and a GxP-compliant validation approach. Go-to-market: Positioning, messaging, input and launch materials, together with the commercial team. Required Expertise 8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences. Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation. Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates. Nice to have: Experience with AI/LLM-based document processing, data pipelines, or platforms such as Veeva, MasterControl, Snowflake or Databricks. Mandate Details Duration & workload: 3–6 months from Jan/Feb 2027, 80–100%, extension possible. Location: Fully remote; no on-site presence in Winterthur required, but possible. Contract: Freelance (self-employed or via your own company) What We Offer A clearly scoped mandate with autonomy in how you deliver it. Direct access to management, engineering and customers, with short decision paths. The chance to shape two flagship products, with potential for a follow-on mandate. How to Apply Please upload your CV and relevant references, availability and daily rate to our recruiting platform. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
